notes.title: BOMB BUG update
notes.content:
New build of the game is up with two small fixes:
- Fixed bug where if the player killed the boss in Crypt Creeper after damaging it with a bomb, the win state would not trigger.
- Fixed being able to drag sliders in the to-do list.

Meanwhile we have a lot of cool SLUDGE LIFE 2 stuff in the pipes, look Devolver Digital up on socials to check out a new BIG MUD single EVERY FRIDAY this month!

peace
terri
